# Palette

Brand kits your whole team can follow

Palette keeps colors, type and logos in one living kit, and checks every export against it.

## Features

### Living brand kit

Change a token, update every file.

### Automatic checks

Catch off-brand colors before they ship.

### Handoff in a link

Designers and developers read the same kit.

## Who it is for

Design teams.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
